description: العربية Stacked Bar Chart Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included The العربية Stacked Bar Chart is the only Power BI visual designed from the ground up for Arabic-language reporting. It delivers accurate right-to-left stacked bar rendering, native Arabic number formatting, and full RTL label alignment — eliminating the compromises forced by standard visuals. Built for financial, operational, and KPI dashboards across government, banking, and enterprise environments where Arabic presentation standards are non-negotiable. Key Capabilities Right-to-Left Layout — Full RTL arrangement and aggregation across all chart elements and labels. Arabic Data Labels — Native Arabic number units: thousands, millions, and billions in Arabic script. Arabic Legends — Optional legends rendered and ordered for correct RTL reading flow. Small Multiples — Segmented views across categories or time periods within a single visual. Cross Filtration — Full Power BI cross-filtering; click any bar segment to filter related visuals. Tooltips & Customisation — Rich hover tooltips and an extensive formatting pane for colours, fonts, spacing, and label control.
